name: Plan my week
description: OpenClaw lists next week's work, Hermes adds what's on at home, and Sochen puts a price on it; if the week costs more than $300, you're asked before it goes ahead. Needs OpenClaw, Hermes and a Sochen key.

steps.ask: List my work commitments for next week as JSON: {"items": [...]}.
List what's on at home next week. Work already has: {{work.text}}
Here's my week: {{work.text}} / {{home.text}}. Estimate what it will cost me and give the total as JSON: {"total": number}.

steps.message: Next week looks like ${{costs.data.total}}. Go ahead with it as planned?
